meta.provider: U.S. Geological Survey (USGS), Short-Term Network (STN) Flood Event Data

fields.hFt: height of the mark above the ground at the mark, feet (null when not recorded or zero)
fields.elevFt: elevation of the mark, feet, in the datum given by vdatum
fields.quality: USGS quality class with its stated vertical uncertainty

meta.notes: A high-water mark records how high water reached at one place. Marks were collected where crews went, mostly along rivers, bayous and the coast; the absence of a mark is not evidence that a place stayed dry.
